_comment: The closed enum of suite commands the trusted measure job may invoke. This file is authority: it lives
beside the workflow, on protected main, and is checked out by SHA. The candidate never contributes a
command - not through a dispatch input, not through its package.json, not through a file in its own tree.
A dispatch may only pick a KEY from this table; the command text is whatever this file says it is.

coordinator.description: the coordinator suite and the coordinator service suite, reported as TAP

coordinator-core.description: the coordinator suite alone, reported as TAP

coordinator-service.description: the coordinator service suite alone, reported as TAP
